license_note: The qwen3-max-2026-01-23 snapshot is served as a Model Studio API model under the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio Service Agreement, effective September 2, 2026, which Model Studio's related-agreements page lists as governing the service. It is a paid-service contract that bars reselling the service or its models and using them or their outputs to train or develop competing products without written permission, and prohibits reverse engineering or trying to discover the service's source code. It grants no licence to model weights for redistribution or self-operation.

license_evidence.scope: Business and developer access to the qwen3-max-2026-01-23 snapshot through Alibaba Cloud Model Studio API services

access_boundary: This record represents the Qwen3-Max line at its current pinned snapshot, qwen3-max-2026-01-23, which Alibaba Cloud Model Studio serves with 262,144-token context and to which the undated qwen3-max model currently resolves. The earlier qwen3-max-2025-09-23 and qwen3-max-preview versions, the Qwen3.6, 3.7, and 3.8 Max lines, open-weight Qwen3 releases, and independent hosts are separate boundaries.
strengths: Alibaba documents the dated snapshot with its own capability, context-limit, rate-limit, and pricing tables, and states that the undated qwen3-max model is functionally equivalent to it
Function calling and structured output alongside switchable thinking, with web search, web extraction, and a code interpreter available in thinking mode
tradeoffs: No downloadable weights exist under the Qwen3-Max name, so self-operation is unavailable
Model Studio gives dated snapshots 30 days' retirement notice, against three months for mainline models
